The grid is counted in eight bands at once with together, each every eighth row so they take about as long: each band only computes, so on Node the compiled program counts them on worker threads, and the answer is the same as counting them in turn.
program:
Counting the Mandelbrot set's area on a grid, eight bands at once (C41).
Prior art: the Mandelbrot set (Benoit Mandelbrot, 1980); its area by counting grid points is the classical estimate (about 1.5066, Förstemann 2012 by pixel counting).
